description: This file provides utility functions for formatting text, such as markdown cleaning, truncating text, and sanitizing session IDs. It's part of the utils module of the project.

methods.name: str format_markdown_response(text: str)
methods.description: Formats and cleans markdown text for consistent rendering, ensuring proper spacing around code blocks, headers, and lists.

methods.name: str truncate_text(text: str, max_length: int = 100, suffix: str = "...")
methods.description: Truncates a given text to a specified maximum length, appending a suffix if truncation occurs.

methods.name: str sanitize_session_id(session_id: str)
methods.description: Sanitizes a session ID by removing non-alphanumeric characters except hyphens to prevent injection attacks.

ctags.name: truncate_text
ctags.pattern: /^def truncate_text(text: str, max_length: int = 100, suffix: str = "...") -> str:$/
